The elongated, reddish-brown, longitudinally cracked/split canker on the tomato stem at a node is most consistent with **Bacterial Canker And Wilt Of Tomato** (*Clavibacter michiganensis*), which is known to produce open, cracking stem cankers with reddish-brown necrosis.
